description: Authored map for scripts/key-papers-admission.ts: the decisions it applies, the mappings onto records already in the dataset, the corrections of the cross-family check, the venue versions it adds and every record it holds, each with its reason. The pack (research/key-papers/pack.json) is never changed.
decisions: Maintainer decisions of 2026-10-28 (review/key-papers-pack-2026-10-28.md): recommended answers 1–10 adopted as written.
adjudication:
Accept the check.
 - LLaMA: four other citing documents only. Move it to basis 2 if it qualifies there, otherwise drop it.
 - Add the printed authors Bo Wen (RoFormer v1) and Kamile Lukosuite (Constitutional AI v1).
 - Keep the version qualification on B010 and B011, which appear only in the October 2018 revision.
 - Add Stuart Armstrong to the Corrigibility author list in B001 and B002.
 - Add the conference and journal versions the check located, at their source precision; Crossref-only dates at year precision.
 Admission steps follow the pack’s decision 10: documents first, then persons and authorship, then attributed-credit records.

1.scope: The key papers admission (2026-10-31, part 1) adds papers and other publications on machine intelligence that dataset documents cite, or that Semantic Scholar ranks among the most cited machine-learning papers, as work-level documents with their arXiv and venue versions as sources; what each says it contributes, quoted (schema 2.24); and the dataset documents that cite them.
1.snapshotDescription: Records as stored before part 1 of the key papers admission (2026-10-31; review/key-papers-admission-2026-10-31.md): the earlier metadata, the IDs part 1 added and the rows it changed, as they were.

2.scope: Part 2 (2026-10-31) adds the persons credited under one identical printed name on three or more of those papers (the first step of decision 3; the second step waits on the maintainer), and authorship as printed in each paper’s byline.
2.snapshotDescription: Records as stored before part 2 of the key papers admission (2026-10-31; review/key-papers-admission-2026-10-31.md): the earlier metadata, the IDs part 2 added and the rows it changed, as they were.

3.scope: Part 3 (2026-10-31) adds attributed-credit records (schema 2.25): a dataset document’s own sentence attributing a term, an argument, a finding or an approach to one of those papers, as that document’s claim.
3.snapshotDescription: Records as stored before part 3 of the key papers admission (2026-10-31; review/key-papers-admission-2026-10-31.md): the earlier metadata, the IDs part 3 added and the rows it changed, as they were.
